The plate is about 26 cm across, including the rim. The steak pieces sit in the center, and the four slices together span roughly 10 cm by 11 cm.

Each slice looks about 2.5 cm wide, 7-8 cm long, and 1 cm thick. That gives roughly 15-20 cm³ per slice, or about 18 g each. The small end piece is probably 8 g.

Total mass is about 3 × 22 g + 8 g ≈ 75 g. Grilled flank or skirt steak is about 2 kcal/g, so that comes to roughly 150 kcal.
